statements.text: The Readiness tab is the command page: every question and every blocking item is a table row with a count and a link that opens the item where it lives, and what settles it is stated beside it in plain words; the viewer is read-only and renders no command text.

The viewer exposes trace, impact and coverage for a selected node through GET routes computed from the current tree, and renders a coverage summary and a trace matrix, so a reader sees how far the chain reaches without the CLI.

The command page works for a human with no agent in the loop, stays embed-safe under embed=1 and both themes, adds no dependency, never writes to rcf/manifest.json, and leaves the computeReadiness signature unchanged.
